scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 32 km this is Trail of the Ancients, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Achenpass
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road

kochelsee-walchensee-jachenau-and-munich.story: A one-way ride of 875 km, Kochel to Rottach-Egern - roughly 15 h 39 in the saddle. On the way it passes Walchensee road, Jachenau valley, Bad Tölz and Kochelsee. near Navis is the high point. It tops out at about 1,300 m.
